bill.title: Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to require that the Supreme Court of the United States be composed of nine justices.
bill.latestActionText: Placed on the House Calendar, Calendar No. 84.
bill.officialSummary: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment requiring the Supreme Court to be composed of nine Justices—one Chief Justice and eight Associate Justices.
